pr_title: Adds New Static Members to LiquidETFUniverse
pr_body:
#### Description
New members represent different ETF categories:
- `LiquidETFUniverse.Energy`
- `LiquidETFUniverse.Metals`
- `LiquidETFUniverse.Technology`
- `LiquidETFUniverse.Tresuries`
- `LiquidETFUniverse.Volatility`
- `LiquidETFUniverse.SP500Sectors`

Each one has a `List<Symbol>` for `Long` and `Inverse` ETFs.

#### Related Issue
Closes #3806

#### Motivation and Context
Add helpers to identify the ETF category.

#### Requires Documentation Change
Yes. This feature should be presented.

#### How Has This Been Tested?
Added algorithms in QC Cloud.

issue_context.title: Add Helpers to LiquidETF Universe
issue_context.body:
#### Expected Behavior
Be able to distinguish the group an ETF belongs (Energy, Tech, Metals) and whether it is Long or Inverse.

#### Actual Behavior
Unable to distinguish ETFs unless we know them.

#### Potential Solution
Adds a class that represents each group and Long and Inverse ETFs.

#### Checklist
- [x] I have completely filled out this template
- [x] I have confirmed that this issue exists on the current `master` branch
- [x] I have confirmed that this is not a duplicate issue by searching [issues](https://github.com/QuantConnect/Lean/issues)

review_comments: Maybe we want this to happen once at initialization?
Yes, sure. I added here because of the recommended pattern of treating the newly added securities in this method.
